name: Beautiful Mistakes: The Theories Science Threw Away
description: Phlogiston, the aether, humours and N rays: the ideas that once seemed obvious, how they were tested, and what replaced them.

checkpoints.name: Ancient certainties
checkpoints.note: The Earth at the centre of the sky, four humours in the body and a world of heavy and light things seeking their place: these ideas seemed to fit what everyone saw, and they were taught for centuries.

checkpoints.name: The age of invisible fluids
checkpoints.note: Chemists blame phlogiston for fire, physicists fill space with aether and heat with caloric, and skull-readers claim to map the mind. Each fluid explained a great deal until careful experiments challenged it.

checkpoints.name: Evidence strikes back
checkpoints.note: Lamarck's inherited habits give way to natural selection, spontaneous generation is refuted, bad air loses to germs, and astronomers search in vain for a planet called Vulcan.

checkpoints.name: Models replaced by better models
checkpoints.note: Relativity makes the aether unnecessary, quantum mechanics replaces the Bohr atom, N rays turn out to be wishful seeing, and the glow of the Big Bang ends the Steady State.
